newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Vidago trade interrupted on Lisbon bourse.
newsitem.headline: Vidago trade interrupted on Lisbon bourse.

text.p: Trade in Portuguese drinks company Vidago, Melgaco e Pedras Salgadas was interrupted on the Lisbon bourse after rumours that the company was the target of a takeover bid, dealers said.
"The sudden price rise and a series of rumours about a possible takeover prompted the bourse to interrupt trade," said one dealer.
"There is a rumour that a domestic brewery is interested in buying Vidago but it is just a rumour," said another trader.
Neither bourse nor Vidago company officials were immediately available to comment.
Vidago last traded up 520 escudos at 2,900 on volume of 9,998.
